Name: Casino Raccoon
Author: RussetGwen
Description:
Description
Gamble on trash items you no longer need for a chance to win some rare and valuable goods.

This mod is currently in Russian only but you will be able to figure the controls out. I am planning to add an English translation in the foreseeable future.

Installation instructions
Download the mod file, unpack it using 7z or a similar program, and then put the mod folder into your Stardew Valley mods folder.

Main features
What a pleasant surprise: you can meet the Trash bear once again. Now he is standing on the town square proudly turning his wheel of trash fortune. Take your chance at winning!

Requirements
SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer.

Shout outs
Shout out to my wonderful community at Моды Сборки Stardew Valley mods for encouragement and support.
